sentences.text: Dimas memakai kaus putih polos di bawah seragam pabriknya.
sentences.en: Dimas wears a plain white T-shirt under his factory uniform.
sentences.ko: 디마스는 공장 작업복 안에 무늬 없는 흰 티셔츠를 입어요.

sentences.text: Putri menulis surat di atas kertas polos tanpa garis.
sentences.en: Putri writes the letter on plain paper without lines.
sentences.ko: 푸트리는 줄 없는 흰 종이에 편지를 써요.

sentences.text: Tim jaga malam di pabrik itu terdiri dari Dimas dan dua teknisi muda.
sentences.en: The night shift team at the factory consists of Dimas and two young technicians.
sentences.ko: 그 공장의 야간 근무 팀은 디마스와 젊은 기술자 두 명으로 이루어져 있어요.

sentences.text: Surat Putri kali ini terdiri dari tiga halaman penuh cerita.
sentences.en: Putri's letter this time consists of three pages full of stories.
sentences.ko: 이번 푸트리의 편지는 이야기로 가득 찬 세 장으로 되어 있어요.

sentences.text: Dimas mengatur beban di rak supaya seimbang dan tidak mudah roboh.
sentences.en: Dimas arranges the load on the shelf so it is balanced and won't topple easily.
sentences.ko: 디마스는 선반이 쉽게 무너지지 않도록 짐을 균형 있게 놓아요.

sentences.text: Dalam suratnya, Putri bercerita sedang belajar hidup seimbang antara kerja dan istirahat.
sentences.en: In her letter, Putri says she is learning to live with a balance between work and rest.
sentences.ko: 편지에서 푸트리는 일과 쉼 사이에 균형 있게 사는 법을 배우는 중이라고 해요.

sentences.text: Saat istirahat, Dimas bersandar di dinding gudang sambil minum kopi.
sentences.en: During the break, Dimas leans against the warehouse wall while drinking coffee.
sentences.ko: 쉬는 시간에 디마스는 커피를 마시며 창고 벽에 기대요.

sentences.text: Putri menulis surat sambil bersandar di kursi rotan dekat jendela.
sentences.en: Putri writes the letter while leaning back in a rattan chair by the window.
sentences.ko: 푸트리는 창가 등나무 의자에 기대어 편지를 써요.

sentences.text: Seekor kucing meloncat ke atas tumpukan kardus di gudang pabrik.
sentences.en: A cat jumped onto a pile of cardboard boxes in the factory warehouse.
sentences.ko: 고양이 한 마리가 공장 창고의 상자 더미 위로 뛰어올랐어요.

sentences.text: Putri ingat dulu mereka suka meloncat ke sungai di belakang sekolah.
sentences.en: Putri remembers how they used to love jumping into the river behind the school.
sentences.ko: 푸트리는 예전에 학교 뒤 강으로 뛰어들기를 좋아했던 걸 기억해요.

sentences.text: Pabrik itu dikelola oleh gabungan beberapa perusahaan lokal.
sentences.en: The factory is run by a group of several local companies.
sentences.ko: 그 공장은 여러 지역 회사의 연합이 운영해요.

sentences.text: Hadiah untuk Sari adalah gabungan foto lama dan kartu pos dari kota-kota yang pernah Putri kunjungi.
sentences.en: The gift for Sari is a mix of old photos and postcards from cities Putri has visited.
sentences.ko: 사리에게 줄 선물은 옛 사진과 푸트리가 가 본 도시들의 엽서를 모은 거예요.

sentences.text: Kata mandor, tidak ada pekerjaan yang kekal, jadi Dimas rajin menabung.
sentences.en: The foreman says no job lasts forever, so Dimas saves diligently.
sentences.ko: 반장 말로는 영원한 일자리는 없대서 디마스는 꾸준히 저축해요.

sentences.text: Putri menulis bahwa persahabatan mereka terasa kekal walau jarang bertemu.
sentences.en: Putri writes that their friendship feels everlasting even though they rarely meet.
sentences.ko: 푸트리는 자주 못 만나도 둘의 우정은 영원한 것 같다고 썼어요.

sentences.text: Dimas menuntut upah yang setara dengan pekerja di pabrik sebelah.
sentences.en: Dimas demands wages equal to those of workers at the factory next door.
sentences.ko: 디마스는 옆 공장 노동자들과 같은 임금을 요구해요.

sentences.text: Di surat lama itu, Sari pernah menulis bahwa laki-laki dan perempuan harus dianggap setara.
sentences.en: In that old letter, Sari once wrote that men and women should be treated as equals.
sentences.ko: 그 옛 편지에서 사리는 남자와 여자가 동등하게 여겨져야 한다고 썼어요.

sentences.text: Para pekerja memakai rompi oranye yang mencolok agar mudah terlihat.
sentences.en: The workers wear bright orange vests so they are easy to see.
sentences.ko: 노동자들은 눈에 잘 띄도록 화려한 주황색 조끼를 입어요.

sentences.text: Putri memakai tinta ungu yang mencolok supaya Sari langsung tahu surat itu darinya.
sentences.en: Putri uses striking purple ink so Sari knows right away the letter is from her.
sentences.ko: 푸트리는 사리가 바로 알아보도록 눈에 띄는 보라색 잉크를 써요.

sentences.text: Dimas memesan selusin sarung tangan baru untuk timnya.
sentences.en: Dimas ordered a dozen new pairs of gloves for his team.
sentences.ko: 디마스는 팀을 위해 새 장갑을 한 다스 주문했어요.

sentences.text: Putri sudah menulis hampir selusin surat sejak Sari pindah ke luar kota.
sentences.en: Putri has written almost a dozen letters since Sari moved out of town.
sentences.ko: 사리가 다른 도시로 이사한 뒤로 푸트리는 편지를 거의 열두 통 썼어요.

sentences.text: Kecepatan maksimal mesin itu hanya boleh dipakai saat ada pengawas.
sentences.en: The machine's maximum speed may only be used when a supervisor is present.
sentences.ko: 그 기계의 최고 속도는 감독관이 있을 때만 쓸 수 있어요.

sentences.text: Putri berjanji akan berusaha maksimal untuk datang ke pernikahan Sari.
sentences.en: Putri promises to do her best to come to Sari's wedding.
sentences.ko: 푸트리는 사리의 결혼식에 가려고 최대한 애쓰겠다고 약속해요.

sentences.text: Bekerja tanpa helm di area pengelasan sangat berisiko.
sentences.en: Working without a helmet in the welding area is very risky.
sentences.ko: 용접 구역에서 안전모 없이 일하는 건 아주 위험해요.

sentences.text: Putri menulis bahwa mengirim uang tunai lewat pos itu berisiko.
sentences.en: Putri writes that sending cash by post is risky.
sentences.ko: 푸트리는 우편으로 현금을 보내는 건 위험하다고 썼어요.

sentences.text: Petugas gudang memindai kode barang sebelum kotak dimuat ke truk.
sentences.en: Warehouse staff scan the item codes before the boxes are loaded onto the truck.
sentences.ko: 창고 직원은 상자를 트럭에 싣기 전에 물품 코드를 스캔해요.

sentences.text: Putri memindai foto-foto lama mereka dan menyelipkan salinannya di amplop.
sentences.en: Putri scans their old photos and slips the copies into the envelope.
sentences.ko: 푸트리는 둘의 옛 사진을 스캔해서 사본을 봉투에 넣어요.

sentences.text: Pabrik itu memamerkan mesin barunya kepada para tamu dari dinas perindustrian.
sentences.en: The factory showed off its new machine to guests from the industry office.
sentences.ko: 그 공장은 산업청에서 온 손님들에게 새 기계를 자랑했어요.

sentences.text: Dalam suratnya, Sari memamerkan kebun tomat yang ia tanam sendiri.
sentences.en: In her letter, Sari shows off the tomato garden she planted herself.
sentences.ko: 편지에서 사리는 직접 가꾼 토마토 밭을 자랑해요.

sentences.text: Setelah gajian, Dimas mentraktir teman satu shift makan bakso.
sentences.en: After payday, Dimas treated his shift mates to meatball soup.
sentences.ko: 월급날이 지나자 디마스는 같은 조 동료들에게 바소를 샀어요.

sentences.text: Putri masih ingat waktu Sari mentraktir dia es campur sepulang sekolah.
sentences.en: Putri still remembers when Sari treated her to mixed shaved ice after school.
sentences.ko: 푸트리는 사리가 방과 후에 에스 참푸르를 사 줬던 때를 아직 기억해요.

sentences.text: Tahun ini pendapatan pabrik naik karena pesanan ekspor bertambah.
sentences.en: This year the factory's income rose because export orders increased.
sentences.ko: 올해는 수출 주문이 늘어서 공장 수입이 올랐어요.

sentences.text: Sari bercerita bahwa pendapatan warung kopinya mulai stabil.
sentences.en: Sari says the income from her coffee stall is starting to stabilize.
sentences.ko: 사리는 커피 가게 수입이 안정되기 시작했다고 전해요.

sentences.text: Pabrik itu punya pembangkit listrik sendiri di belakang gedung utama.
sentences.en: The factory has its own power plant behind the main building.
sentences.ko: 그 공장은 본관 뒤에 자체 발전소가 있어요.

sentences.text: Kota tempat Sari tinggal sekarang dekat dengan pembangkit listrik tenaga angin.
sentences.en: The town where Sari now lives is near a wind power plant.
sentences.ko: 사리가 지금 사는 도시는 풍력 발전소 근처예요.

sentences.text: Anak Dimas merengek minta ikut setiap kali ayahnya berangkat ke pabrik.
sentences.en: Dimas's child whines to come along every time his father leaves for the factory.
sentences.ko: 디마스의 아이는 아빠가 공장에 갈 때마다 따라가겠다고 칭얼대요.

sentences.text: Putri tertawa membaca cerita tentang anak Sari yang merengek minta kucing.
sentences.en: Putri laughs reading the story about Sari's child whining for a cat.
sentences.ko: 푸트리는 고양이를 사 달라고 조르는 사리 아이 이야기를 읽고 웃어요.

sentences.text: Kabar pemberhentian puluhan pekerja membuat suasana pabrik tegang.
sentences.en: News of dozens of workers being laid off made the mood at the factory tense.
sentences.ko: 노동자 수십 명이 해고된다는 소식에 공장 분위기가 팽팽해졌어요.

sentences.text: Putri menulis surat itu di halte, di pemberhentian terakhir bus kota.
sentences.en: Putri writes the letter at the bus shelter, at the last stop of the city bus.
sentences.ko: 푸트리는 시내버스 종점 정류장에서 그 편지를 써요.

sentences.text: Sebuah kontraktor sedang memperbaiki atap gudang yang bocor.
sentences.en: A contractor is repairing the leaking warehouse roof.
sentences.ko: 한 시공업체가 새는 창고 지붕을 고치고 있어요.

sentences.text: Suami Sari bekerja sebagai kontraktor yang membangun rumah-rumah di desa.
sentences.en: Sari's husband works as a contractor building houses in the village.
sentences.ko: 사리의 남편은 마을에 집을 짓는 시공업자로 일해요.

sentences.text: Seorang jurnalis datang ke pabrik untuk menulis soal keselamatan kerja.
sentences.en: A journalist came to the factory to write about workplace safety.
sentences.ko: 한 기자가 산업 안전에 대해 쓰려고 공장에 왔어요.

sentences.text: Dulu Putri bercita-cita menjadi jurnalis, dan Sari selalu mendukungnya.
sentences.en: Putri once dreamed of becoming a journalist, and Sari always supported her.
sentences.ko: 푸트리는 예전에 기자가 되고 싶었고 사리는 늘 응원해 줬어요.

sentences.text: Perusahaan tidak boleh memberhentikan pekerja tanpa pesangon.
sentences.en: A company may not dismiss workers without severance pay.
sentences.ko: 회사는 퇴직금 없이 노동자를 해고하면 안 돼요.

sentences.text: Sari menulis bahwa kantornya terpaksa memberhentikan banyak karyawan tahun ini.
sentences.en: Sari writes that her office had to let go of many employees this year.
sentences.ko: 사리는 올해 회사가 어쩔 수 없이 직원을 많이 내보냈다고 썼어요.

sentences.text: Pabrik itu baru mendapat lisensi untuk memproduksi suku cadang mobil.
sentences.en: The factory just got a license to produce car parts.
sentences.ko: 그 공장은 자동차 부품을 생산할 수 있는 허가를 막 받았어요.

sentences.text: Putri baru saja mendapat lisensi sebagai pemandu wisata.
sentences.en: Putri has just received her license as a tour guide.
sentences.ko: 푸트리는 막 관광 가이드 자격증을 받았어요.

sentences.text: Dimas meminta surat referensi dari mandornya sebelum melamar ke tempat lain.
sentences.en: Dimas asked his foreman for a reference letter before applying elsewhere.
sentences.ko: 디마스는 다른 곳에 지원하기 전에 반장에게 추천서를 부탁했어요.

sentences.text: Sari meminta Putri menjadi referensi untuk lamaran kerjanya.
sentences.en: Sari asks Putri to be a reference for her job application.
sentences.ko: 사리는 푸트리에게 입사 지원서의 추천인이 되어 달라고 부탁해요.

sentences.text: Foto pendiri perusahaan tergantung di ruang rapat pabrik.
sentences.en: A photo of the company's founder hangs in the factory meeting room.
sentences.ko: 회사 창립자의 사진이 공장 회의실에 걸려 있어요.

sentences.text: Putri kini menjadi salah satu pendiri klub buku kecil di kampungnya.
sentences.en: Putri is now one of the founders of a small book club in her village.
sentences.ko: 푸트리는 이제 동네 작은 독서 모임의 창립자 중 한 명이에요.

sentences.text: Seorang fotografer memotret proses produksi untuk katalog baru.
sentences.en: A photographer took pictures of the production process for the new catalog.
sentences.ko: 한 사진작가가 새 카탈로그에 쓸 생산 과정을 찍었어요.

sentences.text: Kakak Sari dulu jadi fotografer di acara wisuda mereka.
sentences.en: Sari's older sibling was the photographer at their graduation.
sentences.ko: 사리의 언니는 둘의 졸업식에서 사진사를 맡았어요.

sentences.text: Ternyata Dimas bekerja bersama teman sekelas waktu SMK dulu.
sentences.en: It turns out Dimas works with a former classmate from vocational school.
sentences.ko: 알고 보니 디마스는 직업고 시절 같은 반 친구와 함께 일해요.

sentences.text: Putri dan Sari sudah sekelas sejak kelas satu SD.
sentences.en: Putri and Sari have been in the same class since first grade.
sentences.ko: 푸트리와 사리는 초등학교 일 학년 때부터 같은 반이었어요.

sentences.text: Urusan cuti harus diajukan lewat bagian administrasi pabrik.
sentences.en: Leave requests must be submitted through the factory's administration office.
sentences.ko: 휴가 신청은 공장 행정 부서를 통해 해야 해요.

sentences.text: Putri sekarang bekerja di bagian administrasi sebuah rumah sakit.
sentences.en: Putri now works in the administration department of a hospital.
sentences.ko: 푸트리는 지금 한 병원의 행정 부서에서 일해요.

sentences.text: Mesin jahit yang rusak dibawa ke bengkel di sudut pabrik.
sentences.en: The broken sewing machine was taken to the workshop in the corner of the factory.
sentences.ko: 고장 난 재봉틀은 공장 구석의 작업장으로 옮겨졌어요.

sentences.text: Ayah Sari dulu punya bengkel sepeda di ujung gang.
sentences.en: Sari's father used to have a bicycle repair shop at the end of the alley.
sentences.ko: 사리의 아버지는 예전에 골목 끝에 자전거 수리점을 했어요.

sentences.text: Pekerja di pabrik sebelah mogok selama tiga hari menuntut kenaikan upah.
sentences.en: Workers at the factory next door went on strike for three days demanding a raise.
sentences.ko: 옆 공장 노동자들이 임금 인상을 요구하며 사흘 동안 파업했어요.

sentences.text: Putri bercerita bahwa motornya mogok di tengah hujan minggu lalu.
sentences.en: Putri tells how her motorbike broke down in the rain last week.
sentences.ko: 푸트리는 지난주 빗속에서 오토바이가 멈춰 버린 이야기를 해요.

sentences.text: Setiap sore seorang kurir datang mengambil paket dari pabrik.
sentences.en: Every afternoon a courier comes to pick up packages from the factory.
sentences.ko: 매일 오후 택배 기사가 공장에 소포를 가지러 와요.

sentences.text: Putri memilih pos biasa daripada kurir karena suka cap pos di amplop.
sentences.en: Putri chooses regular mail over a courier because she likes the postmark on the envelope.
sentences.ko: 푸트리는 봉투의 소인이 좋아서 택배 대신 일반 우편을 골라요.

sentences.text: Setiap sepatu melewati pengujian kekuatan sebelum dikemas.
sentences.en: Every shoe goes through strength testing before it is packed.
sentences.ko: 신발은 모두 포장 전에 내구성 시험을 거쳐요.

sentences.text: Sari bekerja di laboratorium pengujian makanan di kotanya.
sentences.en: Sari works at a food testing laboratory in her town.
sentences.ko: 사리는 자기 도시의 식품 검사 연구소에서 일해요.

sentences.text: Di bawah kepemimpinan manajer baru, pabrik jadi lebih rapi.
sentences.en: Under the new manager's leadership, the factory became tidier.
sentences.ko: 새 관리자의 지휘 아래 공장이 더 깔끔해졌어요.

sentences.text: Sari dulu ketua OSIS, dan Putri selalu kagum pada jiwa kepemimpinan sahabatnya itu.
sentences.en: Sari used to be student council president, and Putri always admired her friend's leadership.
sentences.ko: 사리는 학생회장이었고 푸트리는 친구의 리더십에 늘 감탄했어요.

sentences.text: Jumlah personel keamanan ditambah setelah ada pencurian bahan baku.
sentences.en: The number of security personnel was increased after raw materials were stolen.
sentences.ko: 원자재 도난 사건 뒤로 경비 인원이 늘었어요.

sentences.text: Putri menulis bahwa kantornya kekurangan personel sejak awal tahun.
sentences.en: Putri writes that her office has been short of staff since the start of the year.
sentences.ko: 푸트리는 연초부터 회사에 인력이 모자란다고 썼어요.

sentences.text: Dimas membersihkan cetakan plastik itu sebelum dipakai lagi.
sentences.en: Dimas cleans the plastic mold before it is used again.
sentences.ko: 디마스는 플라스틱 틀을 다시 쓰기 전에 깨끗이 닦아요.

sentences.text: Bersama suratnya, Putri meminjamkan cetakan kue milik ibunya.
sentences.en: Along with her letter, Putri lends Sari her mother's cake mold.
sentences.ko: 푸트리는 편지와 함께 어머니의 케이크 틀을 빌려줘요.

sentences.text: Ratusan buruh keluar dari gerbang pabrik saat sirene berbunyi.
sentences.en: Hundreds of laborers poured out of the factory gate when the siren sounded.
sentences.ko: 사이렌이 울리자 노동자 수백 명이 공장 문을 나섰어요.

sentences.text: Ayah Putri dulu buruh pelabuhan yang selalu pulang larut malam.
sentences.en: Putri's father was a dock worker who always came home late at night.
sentences.ko: 푸트리의 아버지는 늘 밤늦게 귀가하던 항구 노동자였어요.

sentences.text: Bagi Dimas, operator mesin adalah profesi yang patut dibanggakan.
sentences.en: For Dimas, machine operator is a profession to be proud of.
sentences.ko: 디마스에게 기계 조작원은 자랑스러운 직업이에요.

sentences.text: Sari bertanya apakah Putri masih betah dengan profesi barunya.
sentences.en: Sari asks whether Putri still enjoys her new profession.
sentences.ko: 사리는 푸트리가 새 직업에 아직 만족하는지 물어요.

sentences.text: Sebelum bekerja di pabrik, Dimas pernah berdagang sayur di pasar.
sentences.en: Before working at the factory, Dimas used to sell vegetables at the market.
sentences.ko: 디마스는 공장에서 일하기 전에 시장에서 채소 장사를 했어요.

sentences.text: Ibu Sari masih berdagang kue di pasar pagi.
sentences.en: Sari's mother still sells cakes at the morning market.
sentences.ko: 사리의 어머니는 아직도 아침 시장에서 떡을 팔아요.

sentences.text: Pabrik harus menekan biaya karena persaingan dengan produk impor makin ketat.
sentences.en: The factory has to cut costs because competition with imported products is getting tougher.
sentences.ko: 수입품과의 경쟁이 더 치열해져서 공장은 비용을 줄여야 해요.

sentences.text: Putri dan Sari tetap bersahabat walau dulu ada persaingan ketat soal nilai rapor.
sentences.en: Putri and Sari stayed friends even though they once competed fiercely over report-card grades.
sentences.ko: 푸트리와 사리는 예전에 성적표 점수로 치열하게 경쟁했어도 계속 친구로 지냈어요.

sentences.text: Pak Joko, mandor lama, mengajukan pengunduran diri setelah puluhan tahun bekerja.
sentences.en: Mr. Joko, the old foreman, submitted his resignation after decades of work.
sentences.ko: 오랜 반장인 조코 씨는 수십 년 일한 끝에 사직서를 냈어요.

sentences.text: Sari kaget mendengar kabar pengunduran diri Putri dari kantor lamanya.
sentences.en: Sari was surprised to hear that Putri had resigned from her old office.
sentences.ko: 사리는 푸트리가 예전 회사를 그만뒀다는 소식에 놀랐어요.
